name: Planning Poker
highLevelGoals: The Moderator aims to efficiently guide the team through the estimation process to collectively set sprint goals, ensuring productive discussions and shared understanding.
The Moderator seeks to easily manage and modify game details, including adding, editing, and deleting items for estimation, to reflect the team's evolving understanding.
The Moderator desires a straightforward process for creating new games and inviting estimators, minimizing setup time and maximizing participation.
The Moderator wants to control when estimates are revealed and to easily accept agreed-upon estimates, facilitating quick decision-making and progression.
The Moderator aims to have the flexibility to re-estimate stories and import items from external sources, adapting to dynamic team needs during a session.
The Moderator needs to browse, view, and export transcripts of previous games to maintain records and analyze past estimations.
The Moderator expects to create, log in, modify, and delete their account securely, ensuring privacy and control over their data.
The Moderator desires to configure timezones and estimation scales to align with their team's specific working practices and preferences.
The Estimator aims to join games seamlessly and submit their estimates for items, contributing to the collective sprint goal setting.
The Estimator seeks clear visibility of the current item and all items to be estimated, enabling informed decision-making during the process.
The Participant wants to see who has estimated what and receive immediate notifications of estimates, fostering transparency and facilitating discussions.
The Participant desires the ability to view prior estimates and change their current estimate until the round is complete, allowing for dynamic adjustments during discussions.
The Participant aims to initiate and reset a countdown timer to ensure discussions remain focused and efficient.
The Participant wants to review past stories and estimates to inform their current estimations and understand the evolution of discussions.
The Participant expects to see a thumbnail photo and consistent card ordering to enhance the personal and user-friendly nature of the game.
lowLevelGoals: The Moderator can initiate a new game session by providing a name and other initial settings.
The Moderator can add a new story or task to the list of items to be estimated in the active game.
The Moderator can modify the details (e.g., description, title) of an item already added to the current game.
The Moderator can remove an item from the list of stories or tasks to be estimated in the active game.
The Moderator can choose an item from the list to be the active item for the current estimation round.
The Moderator can generate and share a unique link that allows up to 15 estimators to join the active game session.
The Moderator can trigger the display of all individual estimates submitted by participants for the currently active item.
The Moderator can select and confirm a final estimate for the current item, marking it as complete.
The Moderator can manually input a specific value as the final estimate for the current item, rather than accepting an average.
The Moderator can reset the estimation process for the current item, allowing participants to submit new estimates.
The Moderator can upload or connect to an external system to populate the game with items for estimation.
The Moderator can directly paste a list of stories from a spreadsheet into the game session to add them for estimation.
The Moderator can view a list of all previously conducted estimation games.
The Moderator can access a complete record of a selected past game, including items, estimates, and final decisions.
The Moderator can download the historical data of a chosen game in HTML format for external record-keeping or analysis.
The Moderator can download the historical data of a chosen game in CSV format for external record-keeping or analysis.
The Moderator can register for a new account by providing necessary credentials.
The Moderator can access their account by providing their username and password.
The Moderator can update their personal information associated with their account.
The Moderator can permanently remove their account and associated data from the system.
The Moderator can initiate a process to receive a reminder or reset their password if forgotten.
The Moderator can permanently remove a game session and all its associated data.
The Moderator can select the appropriate timezone for the current game to ensure accurate timekeeping.
The Moderator can choose the set of values that participants will use for their estimates.
The Moderator can see all game-related dates and times displayed according to their local timezone settings.
The Estimator can enter a game session by clicking on a provided link.
The Estimator can select a value from the chosen estimation scale and submit it for the active story or task.
The system will automatically populate the final estimate field with the agreed-upon value if all participants submit the same estimate.
The Estimator can see the full context of the story or task they are currently estimating.
The Estimator can see the backlog of stories or tasks that are part of the current estimation session.
The Participant can see the individual estimates provided by other team members once the Moderator reveals them.
The Participant is alerted immediately when another team member submits their estimate for the current item.
The Participant can see what estimate they previously submitted for the active story or task.
The Participant can modify their submitted estimate for the active item as long as the Moderator has not yet revealed the estimates.
The Participant can start a timer to manage the duration of discussions for the current item.
The Participant can restart the timer for the current discussion if more time is needed.
The Participant can access a history of items that have already been estimated and finalized in the ongoing session.
The Participant sees a small image representing each team member in the game interface.
The Moderator/Estimator can input text in any language (Unicode characters) into game fields such as item descriptions or game names.
